title: Emergency room visit
description: An emergency room visit is care you receive when you have a sudden, urgent medical problem. Your emergency care team quickly assesses your condition to determine how serious your situation is and what treatment you need. During your visit, you'll be evaluated, may have tests or imaging, and receive immediate treatment for your acute condition. The emergency room operates 24/7 to handle medical emergencies ranging from minor injuries to life-threatening situations. Your medical team works efficiently to stabilize your condition and decide if you need admission to the hospital or can go home with follow-up care. The cost of this procedure may vary depending on the complexity involved. Categories include low complexity, moderate complexity, moderate-high complexity, and high complexity.
